node.title: CGI: newlines, write exactly "\r\n" to end the headers, then turn off binmode
node.author: 7stud
node.doctext:
Dear Monks

In a cgi script, I want to end the headers. All the scripts I see use print " ";, but as far as I can tell that is incorrect on Unix because " " gets written untranslated as " ", yet the HTTP 1.1. spec requires that the two character sequence CRLF be used to end the headers. So I want to write exactly " " to STDOUT and avoid any newline translations. I can do that with binmode(STDOUT), but then how do I turn off binmode() for STDOUT, so that I can then print regular text in the response body?

Is turning off binmode() documented anywhere? Should I be using syswrite() instead?
